title: Indie dev and solo-founder tools
topic: Low-touch SaaS tools for indie developers and solo founders that one person with an AI coding agent can build and run
question: Which jobs of indie developers, solo founders and micro-SaaS teams (1-5 people) are under-served by current developer and founder software and workarounds, and which could a small SaaS, built mostly by an AI coding agent and run with about 5 human hours a week and a budget under $300, serve profitably (>= $1,000 MRR) with growth built into the product?

picos.population: Indie developers, solo founders and micro-SaaS / bootstrapped software teams of 1-5 people who build, launch and sell web products, apps, APIs or plugins online
picos.intervention: Running and growing a small software product: shipping and deploying, monitoring and fixing, getting first users and launching, collecting payments and handling subscriptions, onboarding and support, analytics and feedback, and showcasing the product publicly
picos.comparator: Incumbent developer and founder SaaS, open-source and self-hosted tools, scripts and spreadsheets, Zapier-style glue, hiring freelancers, doing it by hand, and doing nothing
picos.outcomes: Less time spent on non-coding work, lower tool cost, fewer outages and errors, faster launch and first revenue, more users and signups, less churn and failed payments, less support load
picos.setting: Global, English-speaking online communities; web, browser, GitHub, app stores and plugin marketplaces; companies of 1-5 people

in: Self-serve software sold online to indie developers and solo founders
Tools covering launch, distribution, analytics, payments, monitoring, support, feedback and public showcase
Browser extensions, APIs, GitHub apps and marketplace apps aimed at this population
out: Enterprise developer platforms sold through sales teams
General-purpose AI coding assistants and IDEs (frontier-lab territory)
Products that need regulated data (health, payments custody, KYC) or hardware

include: The product or workaround serves people who build or sell software alone or in teams of 1-5
The page shows a self-serve product, an open-source tool, or a described workaround for a job named in picos.intervention
The product was active (release, changelog, post or pricing update) within recency_days, or the workaround is described within recency_days
exclude: Aimed only at enterprises or teams larger than 50 (sales-only pricing, contact sales as the only plan)
Not a software product, workaround, directory or community (course, agency, newsletter); communities and directories are kept as reach channels per D06, not counted as competitors
General payment processors, banks or fintechs that hold funds or require merchant KYC; billing, merchant-of-record, dunning and license tools sold to software makers stay in scope
Dead: no activity within recency_days or announced shutdown
Duplicate or rebrand of an entity already listed

skills: product built by an AI coding agent (Claude Code) with web, API and browser-extension stacks
human helper for accounts, payments, posting and support triage
exclusions: heavy ongoing manual operations or content moderation
products needing paid ads to grow
unfair_advantages: can ship and iterate fast with coding agents

notes: Human constraints (2026-10-09): Claude Code builds; a human helper does only what agents cannot (accounts, payments, posting); minimal human time (~5 h/week) and budget (<$300); target >= $1,000 MRR. Viral = built-in growth loop observable in evidence (output seen by non-users). Targeted evidence round 2 requested by the user to diversify domains for near-miss gap cards GAP-003 extension payments, GAP-004 outage alerts + public status pages, GAP-007 multi-provider subscriptions, GAP-002 VAT filing, GAP-005 failed-payment recovery.
